animals-01.zh: 狮子。狮子有一圈蓬松的鬃毛，像戴着小围巾。
animals-01.en: Lion. The lion has a fluffy mane around his neck, like a little scarf.

animals-02.zh: 熊猫。熊猫穿着黑白衣服，最爱吃竹子。
animals-02.en: Panda. The panda has a black and white coat and loves to eat bamboo.

animals-03.zh: 兔子。兔子的耳朵长长的，蹦蹦跳跳真可爱。
animals-03.en: Rabbit. The rabbit has long ears and hops along so sweetly.

animals-04.zh: 大象。大象的鼻子长长的，可以卷起食物。
animals-04.en: Elephant. The elephant has a long trunk that can pick up food.

animals-05.zh: 长颈鹿。长颈鹿的脖子长长的，能吃到高处的树叶。
animals-05.en: Giraffe. The giraffe has a long neck that helps it reach leaves high in the trees.

animals-06.zh: 小猫。小猫喵喵叫，嘴边长着细细的胡须。
animals-06.en: Cat. The cat says meow and has fine whiskers beside its mouth.

animals-07.zh: 小狗。小狗汪汪叫，摇摇尾巴来问好。
animals-07.en: Dog. The dog says woof and wags its tail to say hello.

animals-08.zh: 老虎。老虎的身上有一道道黑色的条纹。
animals-08.en: Tiger. The tiger has black stripes on its body.

animals-09.zh: 猴子。猴子会爬树，用小手抓住树枝。
animals-09.en: Monkey. The monkey climbs trees and holds the branches with its little hands.

animals-10.zh: 斑马。斑马穿着黑白条纹的衣服。
animals-10.en: Zebra. The zebra has a coat with black and white stripes.

animals-11.zh: 小熊。小熊的身体胖胖的，耳朵圆圆的。
animals-11.en: Bear. The little bear has a plump body and round ears.

animals-12.zh: 狐狸。狐狸的尾巴蓬蓬的，耳朵尖尖的。
animals-12.en: Fox. The fox has a fluffy tail and pointy ears.

animals-13.zh: 松鼠。松鼠有一条大尾巴，喜欢在树上活动。
animals-13.en: Squirrel. The squirrel has a big tail and likes to move around in the trees.

animals-14.zh: 考拉。考拉抱着树枝，吃桉树的叶子。
animals-14.en: Koala. The koala holds on to a branch and eats eucalyptus leaves.

animals-15.zh: 河马。河马的嘴巴大大的，喜欢待在水里。
animals-15.en: Hippopotamus. The hippopotamus has a big mouth and likes to stay in the water.

animals-16.zh: 企鹅。企鹅摇摇摆摆走路，在水里游得很快。
animals-16.en: Penguin. The penguin waddles when it walks and swims fast in the water.

animals-17.zh: 鸭子。鸭子嘎嘎叫，小脚像一把把小扇子。
animals-17.en: Duck. The duck says quack, and its little feet look like little fans.

animals-18.zh: 猫头鹰。猫头鹰的眼睛大大的，很多猫头鹰夜里活动。
animals-18.en: Owl. Owls have big eyes, and many owls are active at night.

animals-19.zh: 海豚。海豚在海里游泳，会到水面上呼吸。
animals-19.en: Dolphin. The dolphin swims in the sea and comes up to the surface to breathe.

animals-20.zh: 乌龟。乌龟背着硬硬的壳，慢慢地向前爬。
animals-20.en: Turtle. The turtle has a hard shell on its back and crawls along slowly.

fruits-01.zh: 苹果。苹果圆圆的，咬一口脆脆的。
fruits-01.en: Apple. An apple is round and crunchy to eat.

fruits-02.zh: 香蕉。香蕉弯弯的，像一轮小月亮。
fruits-02.en: Banana. A banana is curved like a little moon.

fruits-03.zh: 橙子。橙子穿着橙色的外衣，果汁甜甜酸酸。
fruits-03.en: Orange. An orange has orange skin and sweet, tangy juice.

fruits-04.zh: 葡萄。一颗颗葡萄聚在一起，变成一串。
fruits-04.en: Grapes. Grapes grow together in a bunch.

fruits-05.zh: 草莓。草莓红红的，身上有好多小点点。
fruits-05.en: Strawberry. A strawberry is red with lots of tiny dots.

fruits-06.zh: 西瓜。西瓜外面绿绿的，里面的果肉水分多。
fruits-06.en: Watermelon. A watermelon is green on the outside and juicy on the inside.

fruits-07.zh: 梨。梨的肚子圆圆的，吃起来脆脆甜甜。
fruits-07.en: Pear. A pear has a round belly and tastes sweet and crunchy.

fruits-08.zh: 桃子。桃子粉粉的，有的外皮有细细的绒毛。
fruits-08.en: Peach. Peaches are pink, and some have soft fuzz on their skin.

fruits-09.zh: 菠萝。菠萝头上长着一簇尖尖的绿叶。
fruits-09.en: Pineapple. A pineapple has a bunch of pointy green leaves on top.

fruits-10.zh: 芒果。芒果的果肉金黄，闻起来香香的。
fruits-10.en: Mango. A mango is golden inside and smells sweet.

fruits-11.zh: 猕猴桃。猕猴桃切开后，能看见一圈小种子。
fruits-11.en: Kiwi. Inside a cut kiwi, you can see a ring of tiny seeds.

fruits-12.zh: 樱桃。樱桃小小圆圆的，连着细细的果柄。
fruits-12.en: Cherries. Cherries are small and round, with thin stems.

fruits-13.zh: 蓝莓。蓝莓是一颗颗蓝紫色的小果子。
fruits-13.en: Blueberries. Blueberries are little blue-purple fruits.

fruits-14.zh: 柠檬。柠檬黄黄的，尝起来酸酸的。
fruits-14.en: Lemon. A lemon is yellow and tastes sour.

fruits-15.zh: 火龙果。火龙果的果肉里，藏着好多黑色小种子。
fruits-15.en: Dragon fruit. A dragon fruit has lots of tiny black seeds inside.

fruits-16.zh: 椰子。椰子的外壳硬硬的，里面有椰子水。
fruits-16.en: Coconut. A coconut has a hard shell with coconut water inside.

fruits-17.zh: 柿子。成熟的柿子橙红橙红，像一盏小灯笼。
fruits-17.en: Persimmon. A ripe persimmon is orange-red, like a little lantern.

fruits-18.zh: 石榴。石榴里面藏着一颗颗亮亮的小果粒。
fruits-18.en: Pomegranate. A pomegranate has lots of shiny little seeds inside.

fruits-19.zh: 荔枝。荔枝剥开外皮，果肉白白的。
fruits-19.en: Lychee. Under its skin, a lychee is white inside.

fruits-20.zh: 哈密瓜。哈密瓜的果肉甜甜的，外皮常有网纹。
fruits-20.en: Cantaloupe. A cantaloupe is sweet inside, and its skin often has a net-like pattern.

weather-01.zh: 晴天。太阳出来啦，暖暖的阳光洒下来。
weather-01.en: Sunny. The sun is out, and its light feels warm.

weather-02.zh: 白云。白云飘在天空，像软软的棉花。
weather-02.en: Cloud. White clouds float in the sky like soft cotton.

weather-03.zh: 下雨。滴答滴答，小雨点从天空落下来。
weather-03.en: Rain. Pitter-patter! Little raindrops fall from the sky.

weather-04.zh: 下雪。小雪花飘下来，给大地盖上白被子。
weather-04.en: Snow. Snowflakes float down and cover the ground like a white blanket.

weather-05.zh: 彩虹。雨后有时能看见彩虹，弯弯的，颜色真多。
weather-05.en: Rainbow. Sometimes a colorful, curved rainbow appears after the rain.

weather-06.zh: 刮风。风吹过来，树叶轻轻摇。
weather-06.en: Wind. The wind blows, and the leaves sway gently.

weather-07.zh: 闪电。天空闪了一下！雷雨时和大人待在安全的室内。
weather-07.en: Lightning. A bright flash lights up the sky! Stay safely indoors with a grown-up during a thunderstorm.

weather-08.zh: 雾。雾像薄薄的白纱，远处的东西看不清。
weather-08.en: Fog. Fog is like a thin white curtain that makes faraway things hard to see.

weather-09.zh: 阴天。云把太阳遮住了，天空灰灰的。
weather-09.en: Cloudy. Clouds cover the sun, and the sky looks gray.

weather-10.zh: 星星。夜晚的天空，有好多亮亮的星星。
weather-10.en: Stars. Lots of bright stars shine in the night sky.

weather-11.zh: 月亮。月亮有时圆圆的，有时弯弯的。
weather-11.en: Moon. Sometimes the moon looks round, and sometimes it looks like a curve.

weather-12.zh: 日出。早晨，太阳慢慢从天边升起来。
weather-12.en: Sunrise. In the morning, the sun slowly rises at the edge of the sky.

weather-13.zh: 晚霞。傍晚的云，有时会变成粉红色和橙色。
weather-13.en: Sunset glow. In the evening, clouds sometimes turn pink and orange.

weather-14.zh: 露珠。早晨的叶子上，挂着小小的露珠。
weather-14.en: Dew. In the morning, tiny drops of dew sit on the leaves.

weather-15.zh: 霜。很冷的早晨，草叶上可能有白白的霜。
weather-15.en: Frost. On a very cold morning, white frost may cover the grass.

weather-16.zh: 冰。水遇到足够冷的天气，就会结成冰。
weather-16.en: Ice. When it gets cold enough, water freezes into ice.

weather-17.zh: 雨伞。下雨时撑起小伞，挡住落下的雨点。
weather-17.en: Umbrella. Open an umbrella when it rains to keep the raindrops off.

weather-18.zh: 雨靴。下雨天穿雨靴，让小脚保持干爽。
weather-18.en: Rain boots. Wear rain boots on rainy days to keep your feet dry.

weather-19.zh: 遮阳帽。阳光强的时候，出门记得戴上遮阳帽。
weather-19.en: Sun hat. Remember to wear a sun hat outside when the sun is bright.

weather-20.zh: 雪人。和大人一起，把白白的雪堆成雪人。
weather-20.en: Snowman. Build a snowman out of white snow with a grown-up.

objects-01.zh: 杯子。小杯子，装好水，口渴了喝一口。
objects-01.en: Cup. Fill your little cup with water and take a sip when you feel thirsty.

objects-02.zh: 勺子。小勺子，可以舀起饭菜。
objects-02.en: Spoon. A little spoon helps you scoop up food.

objects-03.zh: 碗。小碗里装着香香的饭。
objects-03.en: Bowl. The little bowl holds yummy rice.

objects-04.zh: 盘子。盘子平平的，可以放好吃的食物。
objects-04.en: Plate. A plate is flat and holds yummy food.

objects-05.zh: 牙刷。小牙刷，每天帮我们清洁牙齿。
objects-05.en: Toothbrush. A little toothbrush helps us clean our teeth every day.

objects-06.zh: 毛巾。软软的毛巾，擦擦小手和小脸。
objects-06.en: Towel. A soft towel wipes your little hands and face.

objects-07.zh: 鞋子。穿上合脚的鞋子，保护我们的小脚。
objects-07.en: Shoes. Shoes that fit well help protect your little feet.

objects-08.zh: 袜子。小袜子，套在脚上暖暖的。
objects-08.en: Socks. Put socks on your feet to keep them warm.

objects-09.zh: 帽子。小帽子，戴在头顶上。
objects-09.en: Hat. A little hat goes on your head.

objects-10.zh: 上衣。伸伸手，穿上干净的小上衣。
objects-10.en: Shirt. Stretch out your arms and put on a clean shirt.

objects-11.zh: 裤子。小裤子，有两个裤腿。
objects-11.en: Pants. A pair of pants has two legs.

objects-12.zh: 书包。小书包，可以装下书和小物品。
objects-12.en: Schoolbag. A little schoolbag holds books and small things.

objects-13.zh: 皮球。圆圆的皮球，拍一拍，跳起来。
objects-13.en: Ball. Pat the round ball and watch it bounce.

objects-14.zh: 玩具车。小小玩具车，推一推，向前走。
objects-14.en: Toy car. Give the little toy car a push, and it rolls forward.

objects-15.zh: 积木。把大块积木叠起来，搭一座小房子。
objects-15.en: Building blocks. Stack big building blocks to make a little house.

objects-16.zh: 图画书。翻开图画书，一起看看里面的故事。
objects-16.en: Picture book. Open a picture book and explore the story together.

objects-17.zh: 椅子。小椅子，坐下来休息一下。
objects-17.en: Chair. Sit on the little chair and take a rest.

objects-18.zh: 桌子。桌子上，可以放书和画纸。
objects-18.en: Table. A table can hold books and drawing paper.

objects-19.zh: 小床。躺在小床上，安安静静睡个好觉。
objects-19.en: Bed. Lie down in your little bed and have a peaceful sleep.

objects-20.zh: 时钟。时钟告诉我们，现在是什么时间。
objects-20.en: Clock. A clock tells us what time it is.

hanzi-01.zh: 日。日，就是太阳。太阳出来了！

hanzi-02.zh: 月。月，就是月亮。月亮挂在天上。
hanzi-02.en: Moon. The moon is up in the sky.

hanzi-03.en: Mountain. A mountain has tall peaks.

hanzi-04.en: Water. Water can flow into a river.

hanzi-05.zh: 木。木，让我们想到一棵树。
hanzi-05.en: Tree. This character makes us think of a tree.

hanzi-06.en: Person. You and I are both people.

hanzi-07.en: Mouth. Open your mouth and say hello.

hanzi-08.en: Hand. Hold up your little hand and wave.

hanzi-09.zh: 足。足，就是脚。小脚慢慢走。
hanzi-09.en: Foot. Take slow steps with your little feet.

hanzi-10.zh: 目。目，就是眼睛。用眼睛看世界。
hanzi-10.en: Eye. We use our eyes to see the world.

hanzi-11.zh: 耳。耳朵听一听，小鸟在唱歌。
hanzi-11.en: Ear. Listen with your ears. A little bird is singing.

hanzi-12.en: Field. We can grow crops in a field.

hanzi-13.zh: 火。火很烫，只能远远地看，不可以碰。
hanzi-13.en: Fire. Fire is very hot. Stay far away and never touch it.

hanzi-14.zh: 石。石头硬硬的，有大也有小。
hanzi-14.en: Stone. Stones are hard. Some are big, and some are small.

hanzi-15.zh: 花。花儿开了，颜色真漂亮。
hanzi-15.en: Flower. The flowers are blooming in beautiful colors.

hanzi-16.zh: 鸟。小鸟长着羽毛和翅膀。
hanzi-16.en: Bird. A little bird has feathers and wings.

hanzi-17.zh: 鱼。小鱼摆摆尾巴，在水里游。
hanzi-17.en: Fish. The little fish wiggles its tail and swims in the water.

hanzi-18.zh: 马。小马有四条腿，跑得快。
hanzi-18.en: Horse. A horse has four legs and can run fast.

hanzi-19.zh: 牛。小牛哞哞叫，低头吃青草。
hanzi-19.en: Cow. The cow says moo and lowers its head to eat green grass.

hanzi-20.zh: 羊。小羊咩咩叫，身上长着毛。
hanzi-20.en: Sheep. The sheep says baa and has a woolly coat.

phrases-01.en: Drink water. I would like some water.

phrases-02.en: Eat a meal. I am ready to eat!

phrases-03.en: Wash your hands. Let's wash our hands before we eat.

phrases-04.en: Brush your teeth. Let's brush our teeth together.

phrases-05.en: Wash your face. Wash your little face. Now it is nice and clean!

phrases-06.en: Put on your shoes. I want to put on my shoes.

phrases-07.zh: 戴帽子。出门啦，戴好帽子。
phrases-07.en: Put on your hat. We are going outside. Let's put on a hat.

phrases-08.en: Go to sleep. Good night. I am going to sleep.

phrases-09.en: Wake up. Good morning. I am up!

phrases-10.en: Read a book. Let's read a book together.

phrases-11.en: Bounce a ball. Let's bounce the little ball.

phrases-12.zh: 抱一抱。妈妈，我想抱一抱。
phrases-12.en: Give me a hug. Mommy, I would like a hug.

phrases-13.zh: 你好。你好，很高兴见到你。
phrases-13.en: Hello. Hello, it is nice to see you.

phrases-14.zh: 再见。挥挥手，我们下次见。
phrases-14.en: Goodbye. Wave goodbye. See you next time!

phrases-15.en: Thank you. Thank you for helping me.

phrases-16.zh: 对不起。对不起，我不是故意的。
phrases-16.en: Sorry. I am sorry. I did not mean to do that.

phrases-17.zh: 慢慢走。小脚慢慢走，不着急。
phrases-17.en: Walk slowly. Take slow little steps. There is no hurry.

phrases-18.zh: 收玩具。玩好啦，把玩具送回家。
phrases-18.en: Put away your toys. We are done playing. Let's put the toys back where they belong.

phrases-19.en: Look at the flowers. Look at the beautiful flowers!

phrases-20.zh: 听音乐。听一听，音乐真好听。
phrases-20.en: Listen to music. Listen to the music. It sounds lovely.
